title: warpdom: a fast, jsdom-compatible DOM for unit and component tests
description:
warpdom is a DOM implementation for JavaScript unit and component tests, written from the WHATWG and CSSOM specifications, that installs as a drop-in Vitest or Jest environment in place of jsdom. On the open-source test suites measured, every test keeps the result it has under jsdom (apart from flaky tests and a short list of documented deliberate differences), and suites run faster drop-in (median about 1.3x), with larger gains where per-file environment isolation dominates run time.

The archive includes the source, the test suite, the Web Platform Tests runner and the research record with its raw data (docs/research). The measurements were taken with dom-api-tracer (related identifier below).
